title: Causally announced House recess transferred to same-day US30 regular-cash long exposure

goal_context.primary_goal: continuous isolated Optimization development around the fixed Live replacement candidate
goal_context.lab_role: one bounded independent-source research unit that may retain at most one exact information seed
goal_context.candidate_effect: unchanged; this declaration grants no integration, implementation, MT5, Tester or Live authority
goal_context.pause_policy: close the whole unit and return immediately to serial Optimization whole-map discovery without a reporting pause

scheduler.selection_reason: The official congressional operating calendar is an institutionally generated, previsible external state with direct primary literature on DJIA returns and no dependence on weather, price, volatility, native signals, exits or portfolio state.
scheduler.distance_from_unit_114: Unit 114 classified a same-morning physical weather observation and traded US500 bidirectionally. Unit 115 classifies a previously announced federal legislative-calendar state and holds DJIA-carrier US30 long or cash; source, mechanism, carrier and side structure are independent.
scheduler.whole_map_comparison: Foreign equity flow was deferred because the primary paper's implementable rule is recursive multivariate model selection rather than an attributable sign rule; primary-dealer data lacked a fixed equity-direction mapping. Programs 1, 3, 4, 5 and 7 had no equally complete independent source-rule-carrier bundle after their adjacent neighborhoods were closed.

literature.paper: Robert P. Lamb, K.C. Ma, R. David Pace, and William F. Kennedy, The Congressional Calendar and Stock Market Performance, Financial Services Review 6(1), 1997, 19-25
literature.source_measure: House of Representatives recess versus in-session dates from the actual congressional record
literature.transfer: FPMarkets US30 long only from the regular-cash open to close on causally known House-recess dates
literature.nonclaim: The 09:30-to-16:00 broker-safe transfer deliberately omits overnight return and neither exactly replicates nor attempts to refute the historical close-to-close paper sample.

source.provider: Office of the Clerk, U.S. House of Representatives
source.causal_classification: Use the latest strictly prior legislative day and its earliest announced future legislative date. Target equal to announced date is HOUSE_OPEN; target earlier than announced date is HOUSE_RECESS.

boundary.source_independence: The family contains no MQL and includes or links no Live, Optimization, Lab baseline or another research family's source.

outcome_firewall.schema_probe_disclosure: Before the family opened, four first/last raw rows were displayed solely to establish schema and physical range; none was a target 09:30/15:59 boundary, joined to House state or used for any return or economic metric.

trade_rule.primary: LONG on HOUSE_RECESS and cash on HOUSE_OPEN
trade_rule.observed: executable exit bid minus entry ask
trade_rule.binding_stress: midpoint gross less the full entry-plus-exit spread burden

controls.matched: equal-weight calendar-month by weekday HOUSE_RECESS-minus-HOUSE_OPEN stressed mean across dual-state cells

economic_gate_summary.p1: positive stressed net, PF >=1.05, net/DD >=1.25, all three splits, >=55% positive months, at least 4/5 positive weekdays, positive matched difference and both frozen control-superiority tests
economic_gate_summary.confirmation: P2-P4 all positive; pooled PF >=1.05 and net/DD >=1.25; at least 2/3 periods positive on matched difference, control superiority and >=50% monthly breadth
economic_gate_summary.prelatest: positive stressed net, PF >=1.075, net/DD >=1.50, >=55% positive months, top-five positive-day share <=35%, at least 4/5 positive weekdays, positive matched difference and control superiority
economic_gate_summary.latest: nominal stressed net >=0; practical loss no worse than 25% of positive prelatest mean times latest primary days
economic_gate_summary.full: positive stressed net, PF >=1.05, net/DD >=1.25, at least 4/5 positive weekdays, positive matched difference and control superiority
economic_gate_summary.strong_null: P1, prelatest and full nonpositive with at most one positive confirmation period

closed_neighborhood: Senate, joint-Congress, committee, presidential or state-legislature calendar
alternate House state, recess length, lead, transition, weekday, month or subgroup filter
direction inversion, House-open short or promotion of either control
close-to-close, overnight, premarket, after-hours, futures, ETF, US100, US500 or another carrier
entry, exit, stop, spread, sizing, leverage, capital, allocation or fixed-candidate integration rescue
